key_insight: A fully local, two-stage LLM pipeline can extract CRF variables from clinical notes while reducing hallucinations by separating presence detection from value extraction.
clinical_relevance: This offers a privacy-preserving, on-premise approach for medical form filling that may fit settings where external APIs and data sharing are not allowed.
method: Used MedGemma-27B in a local deployment
Stage 2: value extraction with item-specific few-shot in-context prompts; no fine-tuning or external API calls
evidence_signal: The approach achieved a macro-F1 score of 0.55 on the official English test track and ranked second among locally hosted, open-source submissions.
watch_item: Performance is moderate, so real-world use still needs careful validation for edge cases, negation, uncertainty, and workflow integration.
paper_title: sebis at CRF Filling 2026: A Two-Stage Local LLM Pipeline for Medical CRF Filling
